meta.title: Rilievi Impianti: the lift survey sheet
meta.description: Fill in the lift survey sheet on your phone, find it again by registration number or address and print it on A4 or as a PDF with your logo. Access on request.
meta.keywords: Carbon Stealth, lift survey sheet, elevator survey, lift maintenance software, elevator inspection form, lift registration number, Rilievi Impianti
meta.imageAlt: Section of a lift shaft drawn in white lines on black, with the name Rilievi Impianti
meta.browser: A recent browser: Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari

hero.title: The lift survey, field by field.
hero.lead: Rating plate, ropes, doors, control panel and machine, the push-button panels floor by floor: the technician fills in the sheet on a phone, the office finds it by registration number or address and prints it with the company logo.
hero.note: There is no open sign-up: each company joins on request, then invites its own technicians.

shaft.title: Section of a lift shaft
shaft.desc: Machine room with control panel, traction machine and governor; ropes, car and counterweight; doors and push-button panels on floors 0 to 4; travelling cable and tensioner in the pit. The numbers point to the sections of the sheet.

legend.title: The sheet, section by section
legend.lead: {fields} fields in {sections} sections, in the order of the paper sheet. Every number is also on the drawing, at the part of the lift the section describes.
legend.extra: Questions that do not apply to the lift stay hidden: the door operator appears only with automatic or semi-automatic doors, the number of locks only if there are locks.

features.title: From the site visit to the office

search.title: Find any lift in a moment
search.text: Search by lift number, registration number, address, make, work order or notes. Results arrive as you type and the exact number comes first.

phone.title: Fill it in on site, on your phone
phone.text: Large fields even for gloved fingers, the unit inside the field and today's date already filled in. It runs in the browser, with no app to install.

print.title: Print it or send the PDF
print.text: The sheet comes out on A4 or as a PDF, with your company logo at the top and the name of the person who filled it in.

orders.title: Order the control panel and the machine from the survey
orders.text: With a Pelazza control panel or a Montanari machine, the sheet fills in the supplier's original form and prepares it as a separate PDF. Pelazza and Montanari are trademarks of their respective owners.

misure.title: Measure the push-button panels floor by floor
misure.text: Length, width, hole spacing and display of the old push-button panels: one row for every stop of the lift.

safe.title: No work gets lost
safe.text: If two people edit the same sheet, the second one is warned instead of overwriting. Deleted sheets stay in the bin and every action goes into the log.

roles.title: Every company in its own space
roles.lead: A company's sheets, people and logo are visible to that company only. Inside, six roles decide who views, who fills in, who deletes and who invites.
roles.caption: What each role can do
roles.note: Everyone invites only roles below their own. The portal administration (Carbon Stealth) creates the companies and can access all of them.

s1.title: You send a request
s1.text: With the form below: name, company and email are enough.

s2.title: We check it
s2.text: We read the request and create your company's space.

s3.title: The administrator gets an invitation
s3.text: A personal link, valid for {days} days, to choose a password.

s4.title: The administrator invites colleagues
s4.text: Technicians and office, each with their own role.

selfSignup.q: Can I sign up on my own?
selfSignup.a: No. Access is only on request: you fill in the form, we check the details and send an invitation to your company's administrator.

visibility.q: Who can see my company's sheets?
visibility.a: Only the people in your company, according to their role. Other companies see nothing; the portal administration (Carbon Stealth) can access all companies.

app.q: Do I need to install an app?
app.a: No. The portal opens in the browser, on phones, tablets and computers.

print.a: Yes: on A4 from the browser or as a PDF, with the company logo at the top and the name of the person who filled in the sheet.

data.a: On a server in the European Union, in a database backed up every day.

languages.a: Italian, Bulgarian and English. Everyone chooses their own language and a light or dark theme.

request.title: Request access
request.lead: Tell us who you are: we reply to the email address you give.

next.title: What happens next
next.s1: We read the request and reply by email.
next.s2: If everything is in order, we create your company's space and the administrator gets an invitation.
next.s3: The details are used only to answer the request and we delete them after {days} days.

request.name: Full name
request.teamSize: How many people will use the portal?
request.messageHint: For example how many lifts you maintain or what you need.
request.privacy: I have read the privacy policy

error.tooLong: Text too long: at most {max} characters.
error.email: Write a valid email address, for example name@company.com.
error.phone: Write the number in digits, optionally with spaces and the symbols + ( ) - . /
error.privacy: Tick the box to send the request.
error.busy: We have received too many requests today. Try again tomorrow or write to {email}.

sent.title: Request sent
sent.text: Thank you. We will read the request and reply to the email address you gave. If everything is in order, your company's administrator will get an invitation by email.

footer.trademarks: The trademarks mentioned belong to their respective owners.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.metaDescription: Which personal data Rilievi Impianti by Carbon Stealth VCC processes, why, for how long and which rights you have under the GDPR.
privacy.intro: This policy explains which personal data the Rilievi Impianti portal processes, why, how long we keep it and which rights you have under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

who.title: Who processes the data
who.contact: For questions about personal data, write to

roles.title: Controller and processor
roles.text: For the public website and access requests, the controller is Carbon Stealth VCC. For the accounts and sheets of a company that uses the portal, the controller is that company: Carbon Stealth processes them on its behalf, as a processor (Art. 28 GDPR), only to provide the portal. For this data, contact the company you work for first.

table.title: Which data, why and for how long

request.data: Name, company, email, phone, city, number of people, message and language of the access request
request.why: To assess the request, reply to it and, if accepted, create your company's space and invite its administrator
request.basis: Pre-contractual steps at your request, Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR
request.kept: {days} days after the request was last changed, then deleted automatically; earlier if you ask

account.data: Email, name, role, company, language and theme, password hash (Argon2id), date of the last sign-in, number of wrong passwords and active sessions
account.why: The account and access to the portal on behalf of the company
account.basis: On behalf of the controlling company (Art. 28 GDPR)
account.kept: As long as the account exists; sessions until sign-out or expiry

audit.data: Activity log: who did what and when (without the content of the sheets and without IP addresses)
audit.why: Accountability for actions and protection in case of a dispute
audit.basis: On behalf of the controlling company; for access requests, legitimate interest, Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR

ip.why: To limit repeated sign-in attempts and mass sending of requests
ip.kept: Only in the server's memory, for one hour at most; never written to the logs

privacy.required: Name, company and email are needed to answer the request: without them we cannot assess it. The other fields are optional.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.text: We use only cookies without which the portal does not work or is not protected. We have no advertising, analytics or third-party cookies, which is why there is no consent banner.
cookies.name: Name
cookies.sessionKept: Until sign-out; {days} days at most ({adminDays} for administrators)
cookies.pre: Protecting the forms before sign-in (sign-in, access request, password) from forged requests
cookies.theme: The chosen theme (light, dark or automatic)
cookies.flash: A one-off message after an action, for example “Saved”

recipients.title: Who else sees the data
recipients.hosting: Hetzner Online GmbH, Germany — the server the portal runs on, in a data centre in the European Union.
recipients.mail: Sendinblue SAS (Brevo), France — sending emails, when enabled: invitations, links for a new password and notices of new requests to the portal administrators.
recipients.text: We do not sell data or share it for advertising. We do not transfer personal data outside the European Union; if a Brevo sub-processor handles data outside the EU, the transfer is covered by standard contractual clauses (Art. 46 GDPR).

security.title: Security
security.text: The connection is HTTPS only. Passwords are stored as Argon2id hashes, sessions live on the server and end immediately on sign-out, on a password change or when the account is deactivated. The web server keeps no request log: it records an IP address only in its log of serious errors, when a request cannot be served. The application logs contain no IP addresses or passwords.

decisions.title: Automated decisions
decisions.text: We make no decisions with legal effects based solely on automated processing. After {attempts} wrong passwords, sign-in is locked for {minutes} minutes: a security measure that lifts by itself. Every access request is assessed by a person.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: You have the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, portability and to object to processing based on legitimate interest. To exercise them, write to
rights.complaint: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Bulgarian Commission for Personal Data Protection (2 Prof. Tsvetan Lazarov Blvd., Sofia 1592, www.cpdp.bg) or with the supervisory authority of the EU country where you live; in Italy, the Garante per la protezione dei dati personali.

changes.title: Changes
changes.text: If we change this policy, the new version will be published on this page with the date of the last update at the top.
